lead_headline: Seven new filings land today, but nothing clears the $4M threshold — closure of Enzo's on Colfax and Carmine's on McGregor adds to July's exit wave

restaurant.blurb: Zero new leads today — tracker holds after Monday logged Nori Den (Red Lotus Den), Carmine's closure (McGregor), Enzo's exit (Colfax).

liquor.blurb: Tuesday freeze persists: zero applications today extends multi-day void as metro licensing hits summer doldrums. Weekly total 95 — down 71% from prior week's 331, confirming post-backlog normalization. No status changes detected after Monday's quiet session. Baseline crawl continues as seasonal lull settles over Denver's liquor licensing apparatus.

reputation.blurb: 5 mentions today led by Instagram membership troubleshooting post, Wire Hub support notice, mayoral State of City coverage. Week climbs to 78 mentions across 14 sources — up 15% from prior week's 68, breaking three-week decline. Instagram dominates at 27, Reddit 13, Facebook 12, Denver Post 8, X.com 5. Notable pickups: food insecurity data, homeless housing acquisition, harm reduction debate. Daily average 11.1 vs. prior week's 9.7 — momentum reverses as mayoral news cycle drives engagement surge.

subscriptions.blurb: Net −1 yesterday (1 new, 2 canceled) erases Monday's positive and drops MTD to −44 (−2.1/day). 90-day net holds at +74. Past 14 days: 28 new vs. 88 canceled for −60 net — 3.1:1 churn ratio worsens from prior fortnight's 2.6:1. July's 22 days yield 31 acquisitions against 75 cancellations, delivering monthly hemorrhage of −2.0/day vs. YTD's +0.9/day. Single-day reprieve proves illusory as defection velocity accelerates into month-end — Q3 trajectory darkens.
